newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Ortiz names new chief advisor at Finmin.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Ortiz names new chief advisor at Finmin.

text.p: Mexican Finance Minister Guillermo Ortiz on Wednesday named Carlos Hurtado Lopez as his new chief advisor, replacing Carlos Noriega Curtis who was appointed as deputy general director of housing development fund Infonavit.
In a statement, the Finance Ministry said Hurtado Lopez was Mexico's ambassador and permenant representative to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development in Paris.
